parsed.notes: Lens B reviewed all five inventory assertions exactly once and did not conduct support or quote-fidelity review.

reasons: The lake record is verified and identifies Utah v. Strieff as a U.S. Supreme Court case decided 2016-06-20.
The lake treatment field lists field_i_validity as good_law as of 2026-06-30, so the disclosed record does not show the authority is defunct or displaced.
Support/home-role merits are outside lens B.
No disclosed treatment or currency defect undermines Strieff's use as a live authority in the attenuation area.
residual_risks: Home-role support was not tested under lens B.

reasons: Support/holding fidelity is outside lens B.
The disclosed treatment judgment keeps Strieff at good_law status as of 2026-06-30, so lens B does not disclose a currency defect in using the proposition.
residual_risks: Holding support and quote fidelity were not tested under lens B.

defect.locator_note: lake/Utah v. Strieff__b45cad.json treatment.derivation.lane2_top_cited; content_page.md Treatment & subsequent history
defect.problem: The good_law field matches the lake judgment, but the page's unqualified treatment language should be narrowed because the disclosed treatment derivation flags an unresolved top-cited audit with proposed negative events.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity as good_law only with the disclosed caveat, and replace any unqualified 'No negative treatment' wording with language such as: 'No adjudicated negative treatment in the disclosed lake judgment; lane2 top-cited audit remains open.'

reasons: The lake treatment field itself says field_i_validity is good_law and point_overrides is empty.
But the same disclosed treatment derivation says lane2_top_cited hit its cap, requires audit, and has 25 proposed negative events.
Defaulting against uncertainty, the naked 'No negative treatment' presentation is too strong on the disclosed record.
residual_risks: The proposed lane2 edges are all marked proposed and field_iii is mentioned, so this does not prove Strieff is bad law; it proves the unqualified no-negative assertion is not tight enough.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Expose the audit caveat wherever the page renders 'good' or 'No negative treatment.'

reasons: The lake identity fields list court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level as scotus.
The content authority_weight 'Binding — SCOTUS' is consistent with the disclosed court identity and no disclosed treatment field changes that institutional weight.
residual_risks: Weight is jurisdictionally broad; the disclosed record does not encode forum-specific limits.
